newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Guilder rates tread water in lacklustre session.
newsitem.headline: Guilder rates tread water in lacklustre session.

text.p: Dutch money market rates trod water in a sluggish Tuesday session, mired by a lack of new fundamentals.
Short-end money rates stayed pinned to Tuesday's levels. Overnight guilders were quoted at an unchanged 2.81 percent bid, with the bulk of deals being done at 2.87 percent, dealers said.

"The market is very slack," one said. "I don't see any substantial changes as long as the current rate picture remains unchanged." Repeated indications from Germany's Bundesbank that it would likely hold interest rates at current levels meant there was little impetus to do business, he said.
The guilder was relatively steady against the mark at 112.33 per 100 marks, compared with 112.345 at Monday's fixing.
